■ Stage Direction
SE: Murmurs
Gender: Male
Age: 40s
Personality: Gentle and approachable

Deliver as if addressing a public group of about 20 to 30 people.
---
★ Request
No standing portrait

Heh... What awakened was your own strength.
Saint Desire merely bestowed a humble blessing upon you.

Why does this strike such a chord in my heart?
Could it be that I'm still...?

...It seems I had misunderstood. I had assumed you were only
able to dream because you had yet to taste defeat.

—Next up is the overseas training program we discussed.
I will now announce the selected participants.

I'm not anyone special.
I should have accepted that a long time ago, and yet...

Why...? It is simple.
Because you are special all the same.
Therein lies your answer, troubled soul.
The World was testing me with trials all along!!
A solitary being known as myself exists right here.

...Ngh.
I'm amazing too, you know...

At last... I have finally made it this far!
Gathering celestial radiance, I will surely reach the Otherworld!!

Ngh...! I am... amazing...! Just you wait...!
...Eeeek! Oww...! That hurts...

............
You, too, are currently battling against some trial, are you not?

("Not bad"? "Another"...?
What is she saying? As if there are other girls out there like me.)
Have you truly never believed yourself to be special?

All she possessed was a childlike, innocent desire for approval.
Yet taken to such an absolute extreme—it was downright refreshing.

I see... Beyond these trials lies a World that shines even brighter...
It was all destiny, which is why the path of racing had to be so harsh...!

Yes, precisely. Just as light dawns every morning, just as apples fall to the earth.
...To me, it is a self-evident truth requiring no second thought.

...I recognize that look in your eyes.
It is the spitting image of my younger self.

Haha, I knew you'd say that!
You've been working extremely hard lately, after all.

Heh... If you would rather not speak of it, that is quite fine.
In exchange, if you will allow me, let me tell you a story.

Oh, right... About that overseas training, a spot actually opened up. What do you say?
You seem a lot more confident lately, and your performance has been nothing short of stellar!

The Saint watched closely from afar, you know.
Witnessing every bit of your hard work...!
Hm...? Such a pretty picture... "Reincarnation in Another World: The Galloping Saint"?

An overseas training program reserved only for top performers... Something completely out of my league.
...I thought I knew my place, yet I still found myself growing restless.

No, you cannot deceive the Saint's eyes.
You bear sorrow in your gaze.

Then, she gazed at me in silence.
Her straightforward words pierced straight to my heart, and my voice escaped in a strained whisper.

My light shall not be clouded by something like this.
For no matter how many times I almost lose sight of it, it remains steadfast within my heart.

Allow me to bestow the Saint's blessing upon you.
A blessing that will allow you to believe in yourself once more...

This is the tale of a girl before her awakening...
A universal myth rooted within the hearts of all—

Heh... Did I not tell you? This is a universal myth. A primordial memory dwelling in everyone.
If that jewel remains locked within your heart, you need only call it forth once more.

...It came as a surprise. She had already experienced it herself.
The bitter pain of learning that she wasn't "special"...

Upon awakening, the girl realized she was a "Saint,"
and set her sights on the distant Otherworld.

Just as expected, my name was never called.
I knew it would happen... yet I still hurried away from the room as if trying to flee...

—The young girl, too, held that belief close.
For so, so, so very long...

Trial after trial came crashing down upon her.
Yet with each one she overcame, the Saint's radiance grew even brighter...

(Something is wrong... I am a special Umamusume.
That's it... It's this World that is mistaken...!)

(Hmph, fine then. Once I take 1st place, they'll see...!
Wait, what...? Everyone is... so... fast...!)

You look rather troubled.
Could you be in need of the Saint's power?

Was it thanks to doing my best following Red Desire's example?
It felt like an opportunity had fallen right into my lap. I'll give it my all and believe in myself—!

—Hey, I have a task I'd like you to handle, do you have a minute?
It's about special remedial tutoring for that restless girl...

When I stepped outside to feel the breeze with a sense of fulfillment, a familiar figure stood before me.
No, she looked so sublime it was almost divine... It was truly an eye-opening sight.

—Man, leaving it to you was definitely the right call! You really saved the day.
You guided her with such an imposing presence!

Whether I'm truly "ordinary" remains to be seen.
No matter how many times I stumble, perhaps someday I'll find my own light.

Hey, who's that girl? Was she always here?
Dunno. More importantly, did you hear our senior is aiming for Tracen Academy—?!

Through unfortunate luck, the girl tripped and sustained an injury.
Even after healing, her constitution left her prone to stomach troubles, and by the time she returned...

Red Desire-san, right? Your entrance exam score was not bad at all!
I'm so glad to see another promising student join us!

—It was a profound shock.
After all, that book told the story of none other than myself.

There has to be an answer somewhere...!
History, social studies, foreign studies, mythology... Mmmgh...

—Indeed...
The racing world, where she was meant to shine the brightest, proved to be a path strewn with thorns.

Her racing talent was especially peerless, leaving even adults in awe.
Emboldened by praise, the young girl stepped onto the racing path. However...

—Once upon a time, there lived a beloved young Umamusume.
Praised for everything she did, she believed without a doubt that she was special.

—The next morning, I felt strangely refreshed.
Perhaps because she had helped me draw out the feelings I had kept bottled up inside.
Seeking further trials, she set off for Tracen Academy—!

—That concludes the five names. If you were called, please come to the faculty office later.
Alright, meeting dismissed.

A one-of-a-kind presence, distinct from anyone else.
The Saint carrying a unique destiny—Red Desire.

—At a time like this, would she
have believed without a shadow of a doubt that she'd be chosen...?

Maybe I didn't need to give up on myself after all...
With that conviction in mind, I began tackling the work right before me with everything I had.

You have attained your own radiance, I see.
Overcoming countless trials along the way...
————And that is how the Saint descended onto this realm.
